findings.claim:
Correction to the 'ERC-7201 constants' framing: the replay mismatch is caused by the source-fallback parser in index.py, not by ERC-7201. (a) index.py pops the enclosing contract off its stack on the inheritance-list lines of a forge-fmt multi-line header (`contract X is
    A,
    B
{`) before the body brace, so it indexes zero members for that contract; 15 of ForestRoadVault's 21 contract-declaring src files (every core contract) use that header. (b) The declaration regex is comment-blind, so NatSpec text such as 'the interface in', 'this optional contract is', 'this library has' creates phantom contracts that re-attribute the following declarations. The replay side (invariants.py) masks comments and finds the 42 contract-level constants/immutables the index missed; 15 of the 42 are ERC-7201 *_STORAGE_LOCATION constants only because in these upgradeable contracts all other state lives inside namespaced structs, which neither parser models.
